literal: In the third month, on wuxu day, the army took Qi Prefecture and killed its prefect Shen Bin.
idiomatic: In the third month, on wuxu day, the army captured Qi Prefecture and killed its prefect Shen Bin.

literal: On gengzi day, Du Chongwei and Li Shouzhen attacked Tai Prefecture.
idiomatic: On gengzi day Du Chongwei and Li Shouzhen attacked Tai Prefecture.

literal: On wuzi day, Zhao Yanshou led the vanguard to press Tai city.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Zhao Yanshou led the vanguard to press close to Tai city.

literal: On jiwei day, Chongwei and Shouzhen led their troops in flight south; they were pursued to Yangcheng and suffered a great defeat.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Chongwei and Shouzhen led their troops in flight south; pursuers caught them at Yangcheng and inflicted a great defeat.

literal: They again drew up foot soldiers in square formations to resist; they fought for more than twenty rounds.
idiomatic: They again formed foot soldiers into square battle lines to resist, and the two sides fought for more than twenty rounds.

literal: On renxu day, they fought again for more than ten li.
idiomatic: On renxu day they fought again for more than ten li.

literal: On guihai day, Jin troops were besieged at Baituanwei Village.
idiomatic: On guihai day Jin troops were besieged at Baituanwei Village.

literal: Jin troops set down antler palisades and made camp.
idiomatic: Jin troops set down antler palisades and encamped.

literal: That evening there was a great wind.
idiomatic: That evening a great wind rose.

literal: At dawn the Emperor ordered the Iron Hawk corps to dismount, pull up their antler palisades, and charge in with short weapons.
idiomatic: At dawn the Emperor ordered the Iron Hawk corps to dismount, pull up the antler palisades, and charge in with short weapons.

literal: With the wind at their backs they set fires and raised dust to aid their momentum.
idiomatic: With the wind at their backs they set fires and raised dust to strengthen their attack.

literal: Jin troops shouted aloud: "Supreme commander, why do you not use your troops and let the soldiers die for nothing!
idiomatic: Jin troops shouted aloud, "Supreme commander, why do you not commit your forces and let the soldiers die for nothing!

literal: " All the generals eagerly sallied forth to fight.
idiomatic: " All the generals eagerly sallied forth to fight.

literal: Zhang Yanze, Yao Yuanfu, and Huangfu Yu led troops out in a great battle; other generals followed in succession, and the Liao army was driven back several hundred paces.
idiomatic: Zhang Yanze, Yao Yuanfu, and Huangfu Yu led troops out in a great battle; other generals followed in turn, and the Liao army was driven back several hundred paces.

literal: The wind grew fiercer; daylight was dark as night.
idiomatic: The wind grew fiercer still, and daylight turned dark as night.

literal: Fu Yanqing with ten thousand horsemen struck the Liao army from the flank, leading foot soldiers forward together; the Liao army fared badly.
idiomatic: Fu Yanqing with ten thousand horsemen struck the Liao army from the flank and led foot soldiers forward together; the Liao army fared badly.

literal: The Emperor rode in a Xi chariot and withdrew more than ten li; Jin pursuers pressed hard, and he obtained a camel and rode it back.
idiomatic: The Emperor rode in a Xi chariot and withdrew more than ten li; Jin pursuers pressed hard, so he seized a camel, mounted it, and returned.

literal: Jin troops withdrew to Baoding Prefecture.
idiomatic: Jin troops withdrew to Baoding Prefecture.

literal: That summer, in the fourth month, on jiashen day, he returned and halted at Nanjing; several hundred who had fought poorly were flogged.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on jiashen day, he returned and halted at Nanjing; several hundred men who had fought poorly were flogged.

literal: On gengyin day he feasted the commanders and soldiers in the Hall of Primordial Harmony.
idiomatic: On gengyin day he feasted the commanders and soldiers in the Hall of Primordial Harmony.

literal: On guisi day he went to Liang Pass.
idiomatic: On guisi day he went to Liang Pass.

literal: In the sixth month, on wuchen day, the Uighur came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuchen day, the Uighur brought tribute.

literal: On xinwei day the Tuyuhun and Biegude all came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the Tuyuhun and Biegude both brought tribute.

literal: On xinsi day the Black Cart Shiwei came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On xinsi day the Black Cart Shiwei brought tribute.

literal: On dinghai day Zhao Yanshou reported that Jin troops had raided Gaoyang and that garrison troops had driven them off.
idiomatic: On dinghai day Zhao Yanshou reported that Jin troops had raided Gaoyang and that the garrison had driven them off.

literal: In the seventh autumn month, on yimao day, he hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on yimao day, he hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.

literal: Jin dispatched Meng Shouzhong bearing a memorial requesting peace; the Emperor answered as before.
idiomatic: Jin dispatched Meng Shouzhong bearing a memorial requesting peace, and the Emperor answered as he had before.

literal: In the eighth month, on jisi day, an edict ordered Imperial Guard Xiao Susa to inspect the herds at North Pass.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi day, an edict ordered Imperial Guard Xiao Susa to inspect the herds at North Pass.

literal: In the ninth month, on renyin day, he halted at Red Mountain, feasted his attendant ministers, and asked about matters vital to army and state; they answered: "In matters of army and state, loving the people is fundamental.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renyin day, he halted at Red Mountain, feasted his attendant ministers, and asked about matters vital to army and state; they answered, "In matters of army and state, loving the people is fundamental.

literal: When the people are rich the army is sufficient; when the army is sufficient the state is strong.
idiomatic: When the people are rich the army is sufficient; when the army is sufficient the state is strong.

literal: " The Emperor agreed.
idiomatic: " The Emperor agreed.

literal: On xinyou day he returned to the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: On xinyou day he returned to the Supreme Capital.

literal: That winter, in the tenth month, on xinwei day, he sacrificed at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on xinwei day, he sacrificed at Mount Muye.

literal: In the eleventh month, on wuxu day, the Jurchen and Iron Li came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuxu day, the Jurchen and Iron Li brought tribute.

literal: On the guihai new moon of the twelfth month he paid court at Emperor Taizu's traveling palace.
idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the twelfth month he paid court at Emperor Taizu's traveling palace.

literal: On yichou day Yun Prefecture military governor Yelü Kong'a captured a Jin spy.
idiomatic: On yichou day Yun Prefecture military governor Yelü Kong'a captured a Jin spy.

literal: On wuchen day, at the La festival, robe and horses were bestowed on tribute envoys from the various states.
idiomatic: On wuchen day, at the La festival, robes and horses were bestowed on tribute envoys from the various states.

literal: In year nine, in the first spring month, on gengzi day, the Uighur came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: In the ninth year, in the first spring month, on gengzi day, the Uighur brought tribute.

literal: On dingwei day the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the Jurchen brought tribute.

literal: In the second month, on wuchen day, the Biegude submitted military registers.
idiomatic: In the second month, on wuchen day, the Biegude submitted military registers.

literal: In the third month, on yihai day, the Tuyuhun sent military officer Xulie presenting a thousand captive households; Xulie was appointed acting Minister of Works.
idiomatic: In the third month, on yihai day, the Tuyuhun sent military officer Xulie presenting a thousand captive households, and Xulie was appointed acting Minister of Works.

literal: That summer, on the xinyou new moon of the fourth month, Tuyuhun Bokejiu came to submit.
idiomatic: That summer, on the xinyou new moon of the fourth month, Tuyuhun Bokejiu came to submit.

literal: That month he went to Liang Pass.
idiomatic: That month he went to Liang Pass.

literal: In the fifth month, on gengxu day, Jin's Yizhou garrison commander Sun Fangjian requested to defect inward.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengxu day, Jin's Yizhou garrison commander Sun Fangjian asked to defect inward.

literal: In the sixth month, on wuzi day, he visited the ancestral tombs and renamed Bisi Hall Longsi.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi day, he visited the ancestral tombs and renamed Bisi Hall Longsi.

literal: In the seventh autumn month, on xinhai day, an edict levied troops from all circuits; anyone who dared harm standing grain would be punished by military law.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on xinhai day, an edict levied troops from every circuit; anyone who dared harm standing grain would be punished by military law.

literal: On guichou day the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On guichou day the Jurchen brought tribute.

literal: On yimao day Zubu chieftain Ela was made tribal chief of his own branch.
idiomatic: On yimao day Zubu chieftain Ela was made tribal chief of his own branch.

literal: In the eighth month, on bingyin day, the Wugu came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingyin day, the Wugu brought tribute.

literal: That month the Emperor personally led a southern campaign.
idiomatic: That month the Emperor personally led a southern campaign.

literal: In the ninth month, on renchen day, troops from all circuits were reviewed at Zhaolin Marsh west of Yuyang.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renchen day, troops from every circuit were reviewed at Zhaolin Marsh west of Yuyang.

literal: That month Zhao Yanshou fought Jin's Zhang Yanze at Ding Prefecture and defeated him.
idiomatic: That month Zhao Yanshou fought Jin's Zhang Yanze at Ding Prefecture and defeated him.

literal: That winter, on the wuzi new moon of the eleventh month, he advanced to besiege Zhen Prefecture.
idiomatic: That winter, on the wuzi new moon of the eleventh month, he advanced to besiege Zhen Prefecture.

literal: On bingshen day scouts were sent ahead reporting Jin troops had arrived; picked troops were sent to cut the river bridge, and Jin troops withdrew to hold Wuqiang.
idiomatic: On bingshen day scouts were sent ahead reporting that Jin troops had arrived; picked troops were dispatched to cut the river bridge, and Jin troops withdrew to hold Wuqiang.

literal: Southern Court Great King Dielian and general Gao Mohan divided their forces and advanced by secret routes through Ying Prefecture; Du Chongwei dispatched Bei Prefecture military governor Liang Hanzhang leading masses to resist.
idiomatic: Southern Court Great King Dielian and general Gao Mohan divided their forces and advanced by secret routes through Ying Prefecture; Du Chongwei dispatched Bei Prefecture military governor Liang Hanzhang with a host to resist.

literal: They gave battle, inflicted a great defeat, and killed Liang Hanzhang.
idiomatic: They gave battle, inflicted a great defeat, and killed Liang Hanzhang.

literal: Du Chongwei and Zhang Yanze led troops to hold Zhongdu Bridge; Zhao Yanshou struck ahead with foot soldiers and Gao Yanwen pressed with cavalry; pursuing the fleeing enemy, corpses numbered in the tens of thousands; Jin general Wang Qing was beheaded and Song Yanjun drowned.
idiomatic: Du Chongwei and Zhang Yanze led troops to hold Zhongdu Bridge; Zhao Yanshou struck ahead with foot soldiers and Gao Yanwen pressed with cavalry; pursuing the fleeing enemy, corpses numbered in the tens of thousands; Jin general Wang Qing was beheaded and Song Yanjun drowned.

literal: Chongwei and the others withdrew to hold Zhongdu stockade.
idiomatic: Chongwei and the others withdrew to hold Zhongdu stockade.

literal: Yiwu Army military governor Li Yin surrendered the city; troops then advanced and encamped on both sides of the Hutuo.
idiomatic: Yiwu Army military governor Li Yin surrendered the city; the army then advanced and encamped on both sides of the Hutuo.

literal: Three li from Zhongdu stockade they divided forces to besiege it.
idiomatic: Three li from Zhongdu stockade they divided forces to besiege it.

literal: By night cavalry was arrayed in a ring guard; by day troops were sent out to raid.
idiomatic: By night cavalry was arrayed in a ring guard; by day troops were sent out to raid.

literal: He further ordered Inner Court chief minister Yelü Shuoguli and Zhao Yanshou to divide forces for siege and guard; he personally led horse soldiers to cross the river by night and come up behind them.
idiomatic: He further ordered Inner Court chief minister Yelü Shuoguli and Zhao Yanshou to divide forces for siege and guard, while he personally led horsemen to cross the river by night and come up behind them.

literal: Luancheng was taken; several thousand mounted soldiers surrendered.
idiomatic: Luancheng was taken and several thousand mounted soldiers surrendered.

literal: Officers and soldiers were sent forth separately to hold the critical points.
idiomatic: Officers and soldiers were sent forth separately to hold the critical points.

literal: Thereupon the army prepared provisions; for three days no smoke or fire was permitted; whenever a Jin man was captured he was tattooed and released.
idiomatic: Thereupon the army prepared provisions; for three days no smoke or fire was permitted; whenever a Jin man was captured he was tattooed and released.

literal: All supply convoys that saw this abandoned their loads and fled.
idiomatic: All supply convoys that saw this abandoned their loads and fled.

literal: Thereupon Jin troops were cut off inside and out; provisions were exhausted and their situation desperate.
idiomatic: Thereupon Jin troops were cut off inside and out; provisions were exhausted and their situation desperate.

literal: In the twelfth month, on bingyin day, Du Chongwei, Li Shouzhen, Zhang Yanze, and others led two hundred thousand under their command to surrender.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingyin day, Du Chongwei, Li Shouzhen, Zhang Yanze, and others led two hundred thousand men under their command to surrender.

literal: The Emperor with tens of thousands of horsemen came to a great knoll, halted his horse, and received their surrender.
idiomatic: The Emperor with tens of thousands of horsemen came to a great knoll, halted his horse, and received their surrender.

literal: Chongwei was appointed acting Grand Mentor and Yedu garrison commander; Shouzhen was made Tianping Army military governor; the rest kept their former posts.
idiomatic: Chongwei was appointed acting Grand Mentor and Yedu garrison commander; Shouzhen was made Tianping Army military governor; the rest kept their former posts.

literal: Half the surrendered soldiers were given to Chongwei, half assigned to Zhao Yanshou.
idiomatic: Half the surrendered soldiers were given to Chongwei and half assigned to Zhao Yanshou.

literal: He ordered Censor-in-Chief Jieli, army inspector Fu Gui'er, and Zhang Yanze to carry the edict into Bian, explain matters to Jin emperor's mother Lady Li to reassure her, and summon Sang Weihan and Jing Yanguang to come first.
idiomatic: He ordered Censor-in-Chief Jieli, army inspector Fu Gui'er, and Zhang Yanze to carry the edict into Bian, explain matters to the Jin emperor's mother Lady Li to reassure her, and summon Sang Weihan and Jing Yanguang to come first.

literal: A thousand horsemen were left to hold Wei; he personally led the great army south.
idiomatic: A thousand horsemen were left to hold Wei while he personally led the great army south.

literal: On renshen day Jieli and the others reached Bian; Jin emperor Chonggui in plain robes accepted the command; he conveyed his mother Lady Li presenting a memorial begging forgiveness.
idiomatic: On renshen day Jieli and the others reached Bian; Jin emperor Chonggui in plain robes accepted the command and conveyed his mother Lady Li presenting a memorial begging forgiveness.

literal: Initially Chonggui had severed the peace; Weihan repeatedly remonstrated and was not heeded; now Yanze killed Weihan and falsely claimed he had hanged himself.
idiomatic: Initially Chonggui had severed the peace; Weihan repeatedly remonstrated and was not heeded; now Yanze killed Weihan and falsely claimed he had hanged himself.

literal: An edict ordered his burial and restoration of his fields, gardens, and mansion, with generous relief to his family.
idiomatic: An edict ordered his burial and restoration of his fields, gardens, and mansion, with generous relief to his family.

literal: On jiaxu day Yanze moved Chonggui and his mother and wife to the Kaifeng prefectural office; Control Crane director Li Rong was ordered to supervise troops guarding them.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day Yanze moved Chonggui and his mother and wife to the Kaifeng prefectural office; Control Crane director Li Rong was ordered to supervise troops guarding them.

literal: On renwu day he halted at Red Knoll.
idiomatic: On renwu day he halted at Red Knoll.

literal: Chonggui led his entire clan out through Fengqiu Gate, with straw ropes and leading a sheep in waiting.
idiomatic: Chonggui led his entire clan out through Fengqiu Gate, with straw ropes and a sheep in hand, waiting in submission.

literal: The Emperor could not bear to look upon it and ordered him lodged instead at Fengchan Temple.
idiomatic: The Emperor could not bear to look upon it and ordered him lodged instead at Fengchan Temple.

literal: Jin's hundred officials in white mourning cloth and gauze caps prostrated themselves awaiting judgment.
idiomatic: Jin's hundred officials in white mourning cloth and gauze caps prostrated themselves awaiting judgment.

literal: The Emperor said: "Their lord betrayed favor; what crime have his ministers committed?
idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Their lord betrayed favor; what crime have his ministers committed?

literal: " He ordered them to keep their posts as before, and immediately appointed An Shuqi Golden Wield Guard senior general.
idiomatic: " He ordered them to keep their posts as before and immediately appointed An Shuqi Golden Wield Guard senior general.

literal: Shuqi stepped forward alone from the ranks; the Emperor said: "Your petition at Xing Prefecture I have not forgotten.
idiomatic: Shuqi stepped forward alone from the ranks; the Emperor said, "Your petition at Xing Prefecture I have not forgotten.

literal: " He was further made Zhenguo Army military governor, for at Xing he had once secretly requested to defect inward.
idiomatic: " He was further made Zhenguo Army military governor, for at Xing he had once secretly requested to defect inward.

literal: General Kang Xiang seized Jing Yanguang and brought him in; an edict counted his crimes with tally sticks, eight in all; he was bound and sent to the capital and killed himself on the road.
idiomatic: General Kang Xiang seized Jing Yanguang and brought him in; an edict counted his crimes with tally sticks, eight in all; he was bound and sent to the capital and killed himself on the road.

literal: In the first year of Datong, on the dinghai new moon of the first spring month, the full imperial procession entered Bian; he ascended the Hall of August Primacy to receive congratulations from the hundred officials.
idiomatic: In the first year of Datong, on the dinghai new moon of the first spring month, the full imperial procession entered Bian; he ascended the Hall of August Primacy to receive congratulations from the hundred officials.

literal: On wuzi day Deputy Palace Secretariat Liu Min was made acting Kaifeng prefect; Qin Jimin, Li Yanphen, and Zheng Prefecture defense commissioner Yang Chengzhun were executed; his younger brother Chengxin was made Pinglu Army military governor, succeeding to his father's title.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Deputy Palace Secretariat Liu Min was made acting Kaifeng prefect; Qin Jimin, Li Yanphen, and Zheng Prefecture defense commissioner Yang Chengzhun were executed; his younger brother Chengxin was made Pinglu Army military governor, succeeding to his father's title.

literal: Initially Yang Guangyuan at Qingzhou had sought to defect inward; his son Chengzhun refused to listen, killed his aide Qiutao and his younger brother Chengzuo and the like and submitted to Jin on his own, hence the execution.
idiomatic: Initially Yang Guangyuan at Qingzhou had sought to defect inward; his son Chengzhun refused to listen, killed his aide Qiutao and his younger brother Chengzuo and the like and submitted to Jin on his own, hence the execution.

literal: On jichou day, because Zhang Yanze had on his own authority moved Chonggui to Kaifeng, killed Sang Weihan, and let his troops plunder greatly, behaving without the Way, he was beheaded in the marketplace.
idiomatic: On jichou day, because Zhang Yanze had on his own authority moved Chonggui to Kaifeng, killed Sang Weihan, and let his troops plunder greatly, behaving without the Way, he was beheaded in the marketplace.

literal: Jin people cut his flesh and ate it.
idiomatic: Jin people cut his flesh and ate it.

literal: On xinmao day Chonggui was demoted to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and acting Grand Commandant, enfeoffed as Marquis who Betrayed Right.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Chonggui was demoted to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and acting Grand Commandant, enfeoffed as Marquis who Betrayed Right.

literal: On guisi day Zhang Li was made Grand Counselor; Jin's Li Song was made Palace Secretariat commissioner; Feng Dao was made Grand Mentor; He Ning was made Hanlin Academician; Zhao Ying was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Liu Xu was appointed acting Grand Mentor; Feng Yu was made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
idiomatic: On guisi day Zhang Li was made Grand Counselor; Jin's Li Song was made Palace Secretariat commissioner; Feng Dao was made Grand Mentor; He Ning was made Hanlin Academician; Zhao Ying was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Liu Xu was appointed acting Grand Mentor; Feng Yu was made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

literal: On guimao day Zhao Ying, Feng Yu, and Li Yantao were dispatched with three hundred horsemen to escort the Marquis who Betrayed Right and his mother Lady Li, consort Lady An, wife Lady Feng, younger brother Chongrui, sons Yanshu and Yanbao, and others to Huanglong Prefecture for settlement.
idiomatic: On guimao day Zhao Ying, Feng Yu, and Li Yantao were dispatched with three hundred horsemen to escort the Marquis who Betrayed Right and his mother Lady Li, consort Lady An, wife Lady Feng, younger brother Chongrui, sons Yanshu and Yanbao, and others to Huanglong Prefecture for settlement.

literal: Fifty palace women, three inner eunuchs, fifty men of the eastern and western shifts, one medical officer, four Control Crane guards, seven cooks, three tea-and-wine bureau officers, three ceremonial guards, and ten stout soldiers were sent to accompany them.
idiomatic: Fifty palace women, three inner eunuchs, fifty men of the eastern and western shifts, one medical officer, four Control Crane guards, seven cooks, three tea-and-wine bureau officers, three ceremonial guards, and ten stout soldiers were sent to accompany them.

literal: On the dingsi new moon of the second month the state name Great Liao was established, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name Datong was adopted.
idiomatic: On the dingsi new moon of the second month the state name Great Liao was established, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name Datong was adopted.

literal: Zhen Prefecture was elevated to Central Capital.
idiomatic: Zhen Prefecture was elevated to Central Capital.

literal: Zhao Yanshou was made Grand Chancellor concurrently Director of Affairs, Palace Secretariat commissioner, and Central Capital garrison commander; civil and military officers and soldiers received titles and rewards in varying degrees.
idiomatic: Zhao Yanshou was made Grand Chancellor concurrently Director of Affairs, Palace Secretariat commissioner, and Central Capital garrison commander; civil and military officers and soldiers received titles and rewards in varying degrees.

literal: On xinwei day Hedong military governor, Prince of Beiping Liu Zhiyuan declared himself emperor; his state name was Han.
idiomatic: On xinwei day Hedong military governor, Prince of Beiping Liu Zhiyuan declared himself emperor; his state name was Han.

literal: An edict appointed Geng Chongmei Zhao-Yi Army military governor, Gao Tangying Zhaode Army military governor, and Cui Tingxun Heyang Army military governor to hold critical points respectively.
idiomatic: An edict appointed Geng Chongmei Zhao-Yi Army military governor, Gao Tangying Zhaode Army military governor, and Cui Tingxun Heyang Army military governor to hold critical points respectively.
